scope: Independent source-to-model visual review of coherent complete above-ground tower exterior; not survey, mechanical reconstruction, or print certification
identity: Tunghai University Priest Bell Tower (畢律斯鐘樓), not alumni bell tower, Luce Chapel or chaplain office
findings: Four broad rectangular upright wall panels are arranged in two parallel rows, each row split by a narrow vertical slit; not four square posts and not a closed room. Front/rear/left-oblique and top renders preserve this topology.
Central passage is visibly open below suspended bell. Wall tops rise above bell yoke without invented roof or high connecting beam.

Gray concrete narrow ends, borders and slot edges contrast correctly with ochre/yellow diamond-pattern broad faces; both inside and outside broad faces are represented. Exact tile count and relief are simplified.

Flared bronze bell, lip, small clapper, continuous dark inverted-U yoke, lateral pivots and central-slot bearing blocks read coherently against official front/reverse/oblique evidence. Mechanical curvature, block shapes and strengthened joints are approximate.

Tower width-to-height, bell-mouth width and upper-third placement agree sufficiently with source photographs for an approximate model. Depth, thickness, base extent and all numeric dimensions remain photo-estimated or fabrication simplifications, not measurements.
Five final render files all match the final render manifest; the reviewed STL matches the builder-notified final SHA256.
No trees, people, source-image textures, rear office, church or falsely complete surrounding campus are included.

Final revision visibly projects both external bearing blocks beyond the broad wall faces, matching the important projecting-block feature in official oblique/side views. Exact block section and contact geometry remain simplified. All five final revised PNGs were reopened and reviewed.

Final material correction reviewed in all five reopened previews: exterior bearing blocks now read as continuous concrete-gray rectangular solids rather than misleading diagonal two-color faces. Updated five PNG hashes match final manifest.
limitations: Official photographs have unknown capture dates; a filename date hint or 2021 upload folder is not verified capture metadata. The university documented restoration in 2022; this does not establish 2026 current appearance.

Source photos do not supply measured drawings, precise wall thickness, exact hidden fastenings, current patina or calibrated material colors. Symmetry, tiled texture count, yoke/block geometry and paved platform are deliberate approximation.

Bell shallow underside and fixed strengthened assembly are not a working swinging bronze bell. Visual approval does not certify physical printability, thin-feature survival, strength, support-free production, slicer compatibility or real-world printing; the builder retains local thin-relief failures in separate QA.
